title: D2P Scene Input
description: Pinned input of a 3D scene build (design decision ADR-021 §4 'SceneInput', §10 'BuildScene'). It names the garment revision, the arrangement, the mode and the mesh profile, and repeats the garment's evaluation pins. 'evaluationKey' is the digest of everything that determines the scene: when any pinned input changes, the key changes and every scene snapshot built for the old key is stale (design decision ADR-009 §14, GAR-016). A scene input never changes the garment. In mode 'physical-simulation' (draft 0.3.0, design decision ADR-029 §5) it also names the garment's simulation configuration and the pinned body model; the evaluation key then covers the body, the solver profile and the material physics as well.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: When the document was produced (UTC). Excluded from the resultDigest.

arrangementId.description: Arrangement of the garment to build.

meshProfile.description: Mesh profile (d2p:mesh-profile) the panels are meshed with.

toleranceProfile.description: Optional tolerance profile results are compared with.

patternEvaluations.description: The garment's pattern evaluation pins, exactly as the garment states them (D2P-REF-007).

simulationConfigurationId.description: Simulation configuration of the garment (mode 'physical-simulation' only, schema-enforced; D2P-REF-003).

bodyModelRef.description: The pinned body model snapshot the garment is draped on (mode 'physical-simulation' only, schema-enforced); 'digest' is its resultDigest. Its body source and avatar profile are those of the configuration's body binding (D2P-REF-007).

evaluationKey.description: Digest of this document without sceneInputId, contentDigest, evaluationKey and every top-level member ending in 'At' (catalog §1.8).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).

sceneEvaluationPin.title: Scene evaluation pin
sceneEvaluationPin.description: Copy of one pattern evaluation reference of the garment, pinned again by the scene input so that the evaluation key covers it.

patternEvaluationId.description: ID of the garment's pattern evaluation reference.

evaluationRef.description: The pinned pattern evaluation; 'digest' is required and equals its resultDigest.

geometryDigest.description: geometryDigest of that evaluation's geometry snapshot.

sceneMode.title: Scene mode
sceneMode.description: 3D evaluation mode (design decision ADR-009 §6). 'arrangement': panels positioned by the arrangement, with deterministic bindings and transforms and no physics. 'physical-simulation' (draft 0.3.0, design decision ADR-029 §5): the panels are pre-positioned around a body model, sewn by their seam bindings and draped under gravity with collision. 'kinematic-assembly' arrives by minor release.
